findings.evidence: The roadmap at lines 654–658 requires points of the pinned Chevalley–Demazure group from Layer 9. Agreement lines 64–66 directly abbreviate `Symplectic.groupScheme` points, while `TypeC/Basic.lean` lines 57–61 and 155–159 explicitly state that no identification with the pinned simply connected group scheme has been proved; `StandardCarrier/RootDatum.lean` lines 34–37 likewise says it constructs no pinning.
findings.fix: First construct the Layer-9 pinned Chevalley–Demazure group and its pinning, prove its identification with `Symplectic.groupScheme`, then define the pinned-side group, root subgroups, and Steinberg map through that construction.
findings.issue: `PinnedGroup` is merely an abbreviation for points of `Symplectic.groupScheme`; no construction or identification makes this the pinned simply connected Chevalley–Demazure group associated to `DynkinType.simplyConnectedRootDatum`, so all subsequent compatibility theorems compare two concrete symplectic realizations rather than discharge L5.

summary: The claimed L5 comparison still substitutes the concrete symplectic scheme for the required Layer-9 pinned Chevalley–Demazure group, so it does not establish agreement with the roadmap’s target.
